# The engine's bank-import-batch-v1 keyed route set (U-06, P25): committing a bank file import
# and undoing an import batch, `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json, with idempotency-v1's
# contract. Append-only for this capability name: `KeySet::BankImportV1` in operations.rs,
# keyed only while the engine advertises `bank-import-batch-v1`. The dry-run preview is sent
# without a key (400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED if one is sent).
DELETE /api/v1/banking/feed/import-batches/{id}
POST /api/v1/banking/feed/import-batch
